_comment: Laptop overfit sanity run 3 of 3 (scripts/run_overfit_tests.cmd): the real 0.6B student on ~3600 s of train audio (seeded subset of the kept reazon_small/emilia_yodas/galgame train rows; the ids are the `subset` event) for up to 30 epochs of ~30 optimizer steps each (step_audio_s 120 of real audio, micro-batches of <= 60 padded seconds; the memory probe halves that or turns on gradient checkpointing if it does not fit the 8 GB), an eval after every epoch on ~10 s of the pooled gate eval sets (teacher-forced + greedy) and a probe on the train subset (teacher-forced on all of it, greedy on a seeded ~10 s of it). Expect the probe KL to fall well below the held-out KL and the probe CER vs teacher to drop. Early stop: once the probe KL has not improved by max(0.001, 2 %) for 3 epochs in a row (never before epoch 3) the run goes to its end phase (final eval, verdict, summary as usual). Viability settings otherwise, SpecAugment off, warmup min(300, 10 % of the ~900 steps), cooldown over the last 20 %, AdamW + fp32 masters offloaded to host memory with the fused CPU kernel (overfit_1s.json has the measured CPU cost, ~1.5-2 s per step on top of the GPU's forward/backward). Expected wall time: at most ~900 steps x ~3-5 s (GPU ~1.5-3 s for 120 s of audio + ~1.5-2 s CPU optimizer; ~45-75 min) + 30 evals x ~15 s (teacher-forced pass over the 1 h subset + ~20 s of greedy decode; ~8 min) + setup (building the 1 h subset cache scans every train shard: a few minutes), smoke and a full state of 8.6 GB after the smoke steps and every 10 min of loop time, the resume points scripts/supervise_distill.py relaunches from after a GPU fault (~10 x 10-30 s) = about 1.1-1.8 h, less when the early stop ends it, plus ~5-10 min per crash and resume. A mini eval (eval.mini) every 200 optimizer steps (~every 6-7 epochs at ~30 steps per epoch; skipped when it falls on an epoch end): the whole ~10 s eval subset + 64 seeded utterances of the train subset, teacher-forced and greedy, under eval/mini/ and summary/mini/. No GO/NO-GO: eval.gate false makes summary.json's verdict "N/A" with the numbers (a 1-10 s eval subset says nothing about the gate); every eval's headline (val / train CER, KL, top-1) is under summary/full/ in TensorBoard and on one console line. To stop it by hand: create runs/<run_id>/STOP.
